Mission Local reported that S.F. State lecturers were told in September 2023 that their spring classes could be reduced or eliminated. The cuts were projected to equal 125 full-time positions; the faculty union said that, because many lecturers work part time, the impact could reach many more people. The university was facing declining enrollment and a budget deficit.
